# Rakuten

> > Rakuten is a global innovation company offering e-commerce, fintech, digital content, and communications services, powered by AI-driven personalization and customer experience.

Rakuten operates one of the world's largest e-commerce ecosystems, integrating shopping, rewards, financial services, and mobile communications. The company emphasizes AI technology, including Rakuten AI, to deliver personalized shopping experiences rooted in the Japanese principle of omotenashi (hospitality).

## Key Topics

- Rakuten AI
- AI Shopping Assistant
- Personalized Recommendations
- Intelligent Search
- Product Discovery
- Omotenashi
- Chatbot Technology

- Rakuten Optimism 2024
- Ting Cai
